storage.applicationDataTrashUnavailable: The current user Trash cannot be used safely. The folder was preserved. Use Finder to manage it.
storage.applicationDataMoveFailed: macOS could not move this application data folder. Quit the application and its background services, then try again.
nav.modelPurpose: Connect a model to ask about file purpose, cleanup risks, startup items and processes.
settings.modelPurpose: What can a model help with?
settings.modelBenefits: Use “Ask AI” beside a scan result to understand a file or folder’s likely purpose, related application and deletion risks. You can also analyze startup items, processes and terminal issues, or ask the AI assistant for cleanup advice.
settings.modelOptional: AI is optional. Scanning and cleanup work without a model.
settings.modelData: When you ask, relevant metadata and concise maintenance context go to your chosen provider; file explanations do not read file contents. Your provider bills usage to your account.
file.ignored: Added to the ignore list. Future scans will skip it. Restore it in Settings.
storage.itemUnavailable: This item is no longer available. Scan again.
storage.ignoreRoot: The entire scan root cannot be ignored.
storage.ignoreLimit: The ignore list has reached 200 items. Remove unused entries in Settings first.
disk.directorySensitiveTitle: Contains {count} possible configuration or credential files
disk.directorySensitiveWarning: These files belong to the selected folder and will move to Trash with the whole folder. Confirm that you no longer need its settings, account data or certificates. Only a few filenames are listed; file contents were not read.
storage.directoryBlocked.root: A disk root, user home or its ancestor cannot be moved as a whole: {path}
storage.directoryBlocked.policy: This path is a protected system, application or credential location and cannot be moved as a whole: {path}
storage.directoryBlocked.excluded: The folder contains an ignored path. Moving it would also affect that path. Remove the ignore entry in Settings first, or handle other children separately: {path}
storage.directoryBlocked.volume: This path is on a mount boundary and cannot be safely moved with the whole folder: {path}
storage.directoryBlocked.special: The folder contains a special file that cannot be completely verified for a whole-folder Trash move: {path}
